note: Recipe modifiers (docs/CONTRACT.md Phase 6c slice VOC §2.1): a recipe whose ingredients are one material plus modifiers joins its output to that material's family. A modifier never joins anything itself. Every row says why.

rows.why: waxing: a waxed copper block is the copper block plus honeycomb, still copper
a hanging sign's two chains: the sign is cut from its stripped log, so it is that wood
the mossy kin: mossy cobblestone and mossy stone bricks are the stone plus moss
the frame of a fence, fence gate, sign, rail or lever: a fence is its planks plus sticks, so it is that wood (sticks alone, as in a ladder, join nothing)
the mossy kin: mossy cobblestone and mossy stone bricks are the stone plus a vine
